title: Progress on Areas of Collaboration Identified during Inaugural Meeting of India-Singapore Ministerial Roundtable
what_it_is: Progress on Areas of Collaboration Identified during Inaugural Meeting of India-Singapore Ministerial Roundtable

sections.label: India-Singapore collaboration progress update
sections.summary: The passage reports progress in five India-Singapore collaboration areas, including the PayNow-UPI digital payments linkage launched in February 2023 and a TradeTrust Bills of Lading pilot shipment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Neil Parekh Nimil Rajnikant
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (a) whether he can provide an update on the progress made in the five mutually beneficial areas of collaboration that are identified in the first inaugural meeting of the India-Singapore Ministerial Roundtable in September 2022; and (b) what is the Ministry’s assessment on the role of the business community, in particular the Chambers of Commerce and trade associations, to achieve the desired outcomes laid down at the meeting.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: These five areas are food cooperation, health and pharmaceuticals, digitalisation, energy and green projects, and skills development.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Since then, the digital payments linkage between Singapore’s PayNow and India’s Unified Payments Interface (UPI) was launched in February 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: This allows customers of participating financial institutions to send and receive funds through their banks or their e-wallets in real time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We also facilitated a pilot shipment involving the digital exchanges of Bills of Lading through the TradeTrust framework.

sections.label: Chambers of commerce business delegations
sections.summary: The passage states chambers of commerce and trade associations help Singaporean companies do business in India, citing delegations led to Gujarat and Tamil Nadu events in January 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The chambers of commerce and trade associations play a key role in encouraging and helping Singaporean companies and enterprises to do more business in India.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For example, the Singapore Business Federation and the Singapore Indian Chamber of Commerce and Industry led business delegations to the Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit and Tamil Nadu Global Investors Meet in January 2024.
